announcements.title: API Gateway: Announcement
announcements.summary: Negative backend deadlines are no longer deprecated The deprecation of negative backend deadline values announced on October 23, 2026 is withdrawn. In an OpenAPI 2.0 x-google-backend extension or a gRPC BackendRule , a negative deadline continues to use the default deadline, the same as 0 , and won't be rejected. OpenAPI 3.x backends still reject a negative deadline. For more information, see OpenAPI 2.0 extensions and OpenAPI 3.x extensions .

announcements.title: Looker: Breaking
announcements.summary: Some elements of the Conversational Analytics System Activity dashboard have been renamed. The dashboard layout and capabilities remain the same. On the Token usage tab, the Conversational Analytics API value in the Feature column and the Feature Name filter has been renamed to Looker API . This value refers to the Conversational Analytics methods for the Looker API. This rename might cause a breaking change if you built custom dashboards that reference the former Feature column or Feature Name filter value.

announcements.title: API Gateway: Deprecated
announcements.summary: Negative backend deadlines are deprecated A negative backend deadline in an OpenAPI 2.0 x-google-backend extension or a gRPC BackendRule uses the default deadline, the same as 0 . Negative values there are deprecated and will be rejected in a future release; until then, creating an API config with one returns a warning in the operation metadata. OpenAPI 3.x backends already reject a negative deadline. To use the default, omit the field or set it to 0 . For more information, see OpenAPI 2.0 extensions and OpenAPI 3.x extensions .
